notes.title: Patch 1 is here !
notes.content:
Content of the patch 

TUTORIAL LEVEL
- Added some informations to help you
- Fixed graphic bug at the last computer
- Fixed hud not displaying in the tutorial
- Added block at the end of the first wall run tutorial

LABORATORY
LEVEL1
- No more falling off the map at the beginning of level 1
- No more running through objects in level 1
- Heavy droid machine gun no longer wait to attack
- Slightly reduced HP of Heavy melee droid
- Reduced the force of jump pad in the teleporter area in level 1
- Enemies won't get stuck at the elevator at level 1
- Heavy machine gun droids added at the first spawn 
- Fix bug for occlusion culling under the stairs at start of level 1

LEVEL2
- Added informations about the wall run system in the "pit" of the second level
- Added a jump pad in the "pit" to avoid being stuck if you having trouble to learn the wall run system

LEVEL 3
- No more being stuck betwen the stairs and the jump pad in level 3

LEVEL 4
- Fix for the lights bugs in level 4
- Fix for the objectives not matching current scene
- No more running through objects

LEVEL 7
- fix for the behaviour of the mecha boss that was not shooting when entering the room
- No more jump off the roof

CITY 1
LEVEL 1
- removal of invisible walls near the stairs
- Enemies will no longer get stuck between garbages

LEVEL 4
- Removed the fences preventing enemies from shoothing the mecha
- Overall increase luminosity while piloting the mecha

Cinematics
- No more text to speech at introduction cutscene
- You can now skip ALL custcenes and cinematics
- No more redudant cutscene after the introduction

Overall
- Jump force buff from 0.85 to 1.0 
- English grammar correction

WASTELAND
Level 4 
- Fix for the nightvision, was not activating when entering the sewers

notes.title: Code angel patch 1
notes.content:
Hello Steam community, after receiving some feedbacks.
We decided to reduce the price of the game Code angel.

Since this is our first game, we had a hard time to have a fair view on our product.

This is why the game is going to be patched very soon.
Unfortunetaly we won't be able to lower the price.
However we will be carefull on the next patch.

Content of the patch :

LEVEL1
- No more falling off the map at the beginning of level 1
- No more running through object in level 1
- Heavy droid machine gun no longer wait to attack
- Slightly reducing HP of Heavy melee droid
- Reducing the force of jump pad in the teleporter area in level 1
- Enemies won't get stuck at the elevator at level 1

LEVEL2
- Adding informations about the wall run system in the "pit" of the second level
- Adding a jump pad in the "pit" to avoid being stuck if you having trouble to learn the wall run system

LEVEL 3
- No more getting stuck betwen the stairs and the jump pad in level 3

LEVEL 4
- Fix the lights bug in level 4

Cinematics
- You can now skip cutscenes at the introductions cinematics
- No more redudant cutscene after the introduction

Overall
- English grammar correction
